stages.approach: Packaging: three titles, three one-variable thumbnails drawn from the rig, the beat outline; the G1 room
research.md, claims.md and script.md under rules/story.md; the G2 room; omni qc story_script (claims) must pass
Arthur, one paid take per line, quoted and approved first
Code-drawn scenes in core/engines/whatif timed to cue words; 720p preview ladder
Owner notes applied; loudness, clicks, opening and similarity checks
The owner watches at 1x with cold viewers
publish.md and upload.yaml; private upload only when the owner asks

line_items.notes: Not estimated. Paid, in Higgsfield credits; quoted and approved by the owner at G3. G1 made no paid call: the thumbnails are drawn in code
